text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooh~...! Nishino Flower is so fast!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I was on edge thinking she might get 
crushed if she got boxed in by the pack, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Skipping a grade really is amazing, huh. 
She feels like a natural-born prodigy...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Huh, but—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't she look like she's really 
suffering?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: Flower-chan, are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Mom, Dad...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You came... to watch me... All the way to 
Sapporo... *gasp*.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, Flower-chan! First, take a deep 
breath... right, Dad!?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text: Um, waaah... T-Trainer...!
choice_data_list: W-Well, let's have them sit down first...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After spending a few minutes calming down 
Nishino Flower, who was utterly exhausted, 
and her parents, who were flustered with 
worry...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —I'm sorry... I'm fine now.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Really? Does your chest feel tight or 
anything? Is anywhere hurting... you're 
not injured, right!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mom, calm down. I'm not hurt at all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "I just got a teeny bit tired, is all."

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
A 'tiny bit'...? It sure didn't look like 
that. Racing really is way too harsh after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's the same for all the other girls...! 
Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, her fatigue is considerably 
greater than the other girls. With a body 
appropriate for her young age, she's 
likely at a disadvantage. It's going to be 
a persistent issue going forward..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's no need to stoke her 
parents' anxieties right now. In reality, 
as long as I manage her properly, it 
should be well within an acceptable range. 
For now...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right, it's totally ordinary. Even so, 
everyone still does their best to run, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So please don't worry too much, okay? I'll 
make sure to get proper rest!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I made my debut! I 
really hope Mom and Dad are smiling.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. You're right... 
Congratulations, Flower-chan!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm going to change... Please wait a 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I made everyone worry...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, I'm nowhere near "fine." I 
need to build up tons of stamina and train 
harder...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Still, is just that not enough? To get 
everyone to recognize that my Trainer is 
doing their absolute best...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(—Like... winning an even bigger race. If 
I do that, all these worries will just 
blow away...!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—Um, and then... was there something we 
needed to decide?
choice_data_list:
I'd like to think about our target race, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how she ran today, I felt it. If 
it's her, she could achieve great results 
even entering Junior Class GⅠ races. But—
choice_data_list:
(Higher-level races put a bigger toll on 
the body.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering today's level of fatigue, it 
might be best not to rush and focus on 
building her body during the Junior class. 
As I'm pondering this...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to challenge a GⅠ race...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I know what kind of race a GⅠ is. It's a 
big race where all the strong older girls 
aim for, and still can't win...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I... want to try running. It might 
be too early for me, but still...!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower spoke as she searched for 
the right words. Her resolve was evident 
from the way she spoke. In that case... I 
want to answer those feelings!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's take on a G1!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among Junior Class GⅠ races, considering 
the distance, the mile race 'Asahi Hai 
Futurity Stakes'—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Either that, or the Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies would be a good fit for Nishino 
Flower."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I'd like to try running in 
the Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A race where so many wonderful big sisters 
ran together, just like Gold City-san...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I've looked up to it for a long time. I 
wanted to run like that too...!"
choice_data_list: Then let's take on the Hanshin JF!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I... will do my best!
choice_data_list: (I need to... work even harder too.)
(I need to... try even harder, too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her utterly exhausted after the 
race, I ended up losing my composure, of 
all things. I must study harder so I never 
show such unreliability again—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—All riiight... Time to plant a whole 
bunch!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, my~ You're all fired up, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san. Hello there, are you taking a 
nap?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, pretty much. More. Impor. Tantly~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on your debut~. As a 'Good Job 
Award' from Sei-chan, here's a round of 
applause for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *clap clap clap*~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Seiun Sky-san. A slightly quirky person 
who always looks out for me so kindly.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now then, spotlight Umamusume Flower-san! 
A question for you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing right now? You've been 
eagerly digging up the dirt for a while 
now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Yes, we are making a new flowerbed. 
............

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...You see, I have a secret. It's a 
secret. But...♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup. I won't tell a soul. Won't you tell 
just Sei-chan?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I want to make a flowerbed 
with the theme 'For Trainer-san.'"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Every time I run in a race, I'll plant 
more flowers. Someday, when the flowerbed 
is full, I want to show it to you, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Doing that gives me courage... ...and 
confidence knowing that I've worked this 
hard to get here!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So, back then...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(“Because I was with you, so many 
beautiful flowers were able to bloom.” 
...That's what I want to tell them.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ah-ah, makes ya jealous, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nn-nope. In that case, we'll just have to 
run a lot!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will work hard on that...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, do your best~. Now then, I think I'll 
go get my hands dirty in the soil too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you sure? Your uniform will get 
dirty...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I always end up with grass stuck to me 
anyway~ Also, here's a Sei-chan exclusive 
life hack for ya."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I show up in front of King all 
dirty, she cleans me right up. Though I 
get a lecture with it. So no problem at 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-You don't have to push yourself so hard, 
I'll wash it...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Um, I guess I should tidy up around here.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Sky-san♪
